label: Medicaid paid amount
description: Medicaid and CHIP payments for outpatient and professional claim lines attributed to provider practice location in 2024

source.label: HHS Open Data Medicaid Provider Spending by HCPCS

caveat: These are aggregate Medicaid and CHIP payments, not findings of fraud. Geography reflects the provider practice ZIP in NPPES, not the patient residence or service location. The source suppresses cells with fewer than 12 patients or claim lines.
